issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs that the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) should be implemented as public for easier testing, but both the template and the provided solution declare this helper as private. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended API and may prevent external tests or student code from invoking the helper as described.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) public in the template (and in the solution if intended) to match the problem statement. Alternatively, if the method should remain private, update the problem statement to remove the requirement that it be public and clarify how the verses will be tested.
